card: Backports three merged pull requests to the 32.x release branch for the 32.2 minor release. It resolves cross-architecture Guix build configuration failures, ensures depends local package tarballs do not collide across checkouts sharing SOURCES_PATH, and fixes an AttributeError in combine_logs.py when parsing mainnet test logs. All constituent changes have already landed on master.
evidence: Commit baf46aa6c1 (#36709): 'a --system=aarch64-linux build on an x86_64 machine configured the aarch64 toolchain with --build=x86_64-guix-linux-gnu, and gcc-cross failed to configure.'

Commit 76b0e368ce (#35765): 'when SOURCES_PATH is shared between checkouts, a checkout can find another checkout's tarball, see no newer files, and build from the wrong sources. This happens reliably with contrib/guix/guix-build...'

Commit 8815bc6465 (#36982): 'Mainnet functional tests write debug.log directly under node0/... the recursive glob finds it, but the regex still expects a chain subdirectory and raises AttributeError.'
problem: The 32.x maintenance branch lacks fixes for Guix cross-architecture builds (which failed during gcc-cross configuration), suffers from depends building against stale tarballs when sharing SOURCES_PATH across checkouts, and fails in combine_logs.py when encountering mainnet node logs.

risk.why: Touches only build scripts (Guix/depends), test utilities, and release notes on a maintenance branch, with no changes to node runtime or consensus code.

scope_notes: Standard maintenance backport bundle for the 32.x branch, containing clean cherry-picks of already merged master PRs (#35765, #36709, #36982).
summary: Backports three changes to the 32.x maintenance branch for release 32.2. It updates depends to isolate local package tarballs inside WORK_PATH, fixes Guix build triplet evaluation for cross-architecture builds, and fixes combine_logs.py to handle mainnet functional test logs without raising an unhandled exception.
